sets.title: Сам vs Самый
sets.description: Choose between сам (personally) and самый (the most/very)

items.prompt: Она _____ приготовила этот торт. (She herself made this cake.)
items.promptEnglish: She made this cake herself (personally).
items.explanation: Сама = herself/personally. She personally made the cake.

items.prompt: Это _____ красивый город в стране. (This is the most beautiful city in the country.)
items.promptEnglish: This is the most beautiful city in the country.
items.explanation: Самый + adjective = superlative: самый красивый (the most beautiful).

items.prompt: Мы живём в _____ центре города. (We live in the very center of the city.)
items.promptEnglish: We live in the very center of the city.
items.hint: In the very (center) = в самом (prepositional of самый).
items.explanation: Самый = 'very' (emphasizing exact location): в самом центре.

items.prompt: Директор _____ решил эту проблему. (The director himself solved this problem.)
items.promptEnglish: The director personally solved this problem.
items.explanation: Сам = himself/personally. The director did it in person.

items.prompt: Это произошло в _____ начале фильма. (This happened at the very beginning of the film.)
items.promptEnglish: This happened at the very beginning of the film.
items.hint: At the very (beginning) = в самом (prepositional of самый).
items.explanation: В самом начале = at the very beginning. Самый for emphasis.

items.prompt: Дети _____ убрали комнату. (The children cleaned the room themselves.)
items.promptEnglish: The children cleaned up by themselves.
items.explanation: Сами = themselves. Plural form of сам.

items.prompt: Она _____ лучшая студентка в группе. (She is the best student in the group.)
items.promptEnglish: She is the very best student in the group.
items.explanation: Самая + adjective (fem) = superlative: самая лучшая.

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ сильный человек. (He is the strongest person.)
Он _____ это сделал. (He did it himself.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Personally: сам это сделал = did it himself.

minimalPairs.context: Мы были в _____ конце очереди. (at the very end)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: We were at the very end of the line.
minimalPairs.explanation: В самом конце = at the very end. Самый for emphatic 'very.'

minimalPairs.context: Мы _____ туда пошли. (we went there ourselves)

sets.title: Весь, Каждый, Любой
sets.description: Choose between all/whole, each/every, and any

items.prompt: Я работал _____ день. (I worked all day / the whole day.)
items.promptEnglish: I worked all day long.
items.hint: The whole / all of (one particular day) = весь.
items.explanation: Весь день = all day / the whole day. One continuous period.

items.prompt: _____ утро я пью кофе. (Every morning I drink coffee.)
items.promptEnglish: Every morning I drink coffee.
items.hint: Every (repeating) = каждый. Утро is neuter: каждое.
items.explanation: Каждое утро = every morning. Repeating individual instances.

items.prompt: _____ ребёнок может научиться этому. (Any child can learn this.)
items.promptEnglish: Any child whatsoever can learn this.
items.explanation: Любой = any (whatsoever). No restrictions on which child.

items.prompt: _____ люди любят музыку. (All people love music.)
items.promptEnglish: All people love music.
items.explanation: Все люди = all people. Plural of весь.

items.prompt: Он съел _____ пиццу! (He ate the whole pizza!)
items.promptEnglish: He ate the entire pizza!
items.explanation: Всю пиццу = the whole pizza. Feminine accusative of весь.

items.prompt: Приходите в _____ время. (Come at any time.)
items.promptEnglish: Come at any time (whenever you want).
items.explanation: В любое время = at any time. No restrictions.

items.prompt: _____ вечер мы гуляем в парке. (Every evening we walk in the park.)
items.promptEnglish: Every evening we take a walk in the park.
items.explanation: Каждый вечер = every evening. Regular repetition.

sets.title: Fix and Build
sets.description: Fix сам/самый confusion and build sentences
sets.descriptionRussian: Исправьте ошибки сам/самый и постройте предложения

errorCorrection.sentence: Это сам красивый парк в городе.
errorCorrection.hint: The most beautiful = самый (superlative), not сам (personally).
errorCorrection.explanation: Superlative requires самый: самый красивый парк.

errorCorrection.hint: Personally/herself = сама, not самая (which is superlative feminine).
errorCorrection.explanation: Personally: сама приготовила. Самая = the most (superlative).

errorCorrection.sentence: Я работал каждый день без перерыва. (intended: all day without a break)
errorCorrection.hint: All day (duration) = весь. Каждый день = every day (repetition).
errorCorrection.explanation: Duration: весь день (all day long). Каждый день means every day, not all day.

errorCorrection.sentence: Каждый человек может прийти, без ограничений.
errorCorrection.hint: 'Any person whatsoever' (no restrictions) = любой, not каждый (every individual).

translation.english: She herself told me about this.
translation.answer: Она сама мне об этом рассказала.
acceptableVariants: Она сама рассказала мне об этом.

translation.english: This is the longest river in Russia.
translation.answer: Это самая длинная река в России.

translation.english: I read the whole book in one day.
translation.answer: Я прочитал всю книгу за один день.
acceptableVariants: Я прочитала всю книгу за один день.
translation.hint: The whole (feminine accusative) = всю. Book = книгу.

items.prompt: Дети _____ сделали уроки, без помощи родителей. (The children did their homework by themselves.)
items.promptEnglish: The children did their homework by themselves.
items.explanation: Сами = by themselves. Plural emphatic pronoun.

items.prompt: Мы прошли _____ путь пешком. (We walked the entire way on foot.)
items.promptEnglish: We walked the entire way on foot.
items.explanation: Весь путь = the entire way. Complete duration/distance.

items.prompt: _____ ученик получил подарок. (Every student received a gift.)
items.promptEnglish: Each and every student received a gift.
items.explanation: Каждый ученик = every student (each individual).

items.prompt: Это можно купить в _____ магазине. (You can buy this in any store.)
items.promptEnglish: You can buy this in any store whatsoever.
items.explanation: В любом магазине = in any store. No restrictions on which.

items.prompt: Мы стояли в _____ конце очереди. (We stood at the very end of the line.)
items.promptEnglish: We stood at the very end of the line.
items.hint: At the very (end) = в самом (emphatic exact location).
items.explanation: В самом конце = at the very end. Самый for emphatic 'very.'

items.prompt: Which word makes a superlative (the most + adjective)?
items.promptEnglish: Which word is used to form superlatives?
items.hint: The most beautiful, the biggest, the best = самый + adjective.
items.explanation: Самый + adjective = superlative: самый большой, самый красивый.

patternRecognition.question: How can you tell сам apart from самый in speech?
options: Сам is always followed by a verb; самый by an adjective
Сам has short forms (сам/сама/сами); самый has full adjective forms (самый/самая/самые)
They sound the same and are always interchangeable
patternRecognition.answer: Сам has short forms (сам/сама/сами); самый has full adjective forms (самый/самая/самые)
patternRecognition.explanation: Сам/сама/сами are short-form emphatic. Самый/самая/самое are full adjective forms for superlatives.

patternRecognition.sentence: весь день / каждый день / любой день
patternRecognition.question: What is the difference between these three?
options: Весь = the whole day, каждый = every day, любой = any day
They all mean the same thing
Весь = every day, каждый = any day, любой = the whole day
patternRecognition.answer: Весь = the whole day, каждый = every day, любой = any day
patternRecognition.explanation: Весь день = all day (duration). Каждый день = every day (repetition). Любой день = any day (no restriction).

blanks: Он проспал _____ утро и опоздал на работу. (He slept through the whole morning.)
_____ раз, когда я приезжаю, она готовит борщ. (Every time I visit, she makes borscht.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Весь for duration, каждый for repetition
hints: The whole morning (duration) = всё (neuter of весь).
explanations: Всё утро = the whole morning. Duration, neuter form.
Каждый раз = every time. Repeating individual instances.
